lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hne
  have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' (real_inner_self_nonneg' (x := f x₀)) (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx₀)
  have hc0 : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' (f : Y → V) (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ :=
    Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp ((IsOpen.preimage hc0 isOpen_Ioi).mem_nhds h0)
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  have key := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases h : dist x x₀ < δ
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball (Metric.mem_ball.mpr h)).le
    · rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp h), zero_mul]
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
    integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero (Continuous.mul φ.continuous hc0)
      ((Continuous.mul φ.continuous hc0).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right) hnn
      (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)).ne' h0.ne')
  exact lt_irrefl 0 (lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (le_of_eq key))
